mappings.sparqlSnippet: SELECT ?raider (SUM(?pts) AS ?totalPoints) WHERE { ?raid a kab:Raid ; kab:raider ?raider ; kab:raidPoints ?pts . } GROUP BY ?raider
SELECT ?defender (COUNT(?raid) AS ?tackles) WHERE { ?raid a kab:Raid ; kab:tackledBy ?defender . } GROUP BY ?defender

SELECT ?seq ?homeScore ?awayScore ?homeOnMat ?awayOnMat WHERE { ?action a sport:Action ; sport:sequenceNumber ?seq ; kab:homeScore ?homeScore ; kab:awayScore ?awayScore ; kab:homeOnMat ?homeOnMat ; kab:awayOnMat ?awayOnMat . } ORDER BY ?seq

mappings.formula: P(Outcome | defendersOnMat, doOrDie, raiderPrior) enforcing SHACL kabaddi rule constraints
mappings.sparqlSnippet: SELECT ?defs ?dod ?outcome WHERE { ?raid a kab:Raid ; kab:defendersOnMat ?defs ; kab:doOrDie ?dod ; kab:raidOutcome ?outcome . }
